title: EP 10 — TURN ANY WORKFLOW INTO A REUSABLE SKILL
sub: A SKILL.md packages a repeatable workflow as a capability Claude can reuse
lines: Pasting the same multi-step instructions into Claude over and over?
Pasting the same multi-step instructions, into Clawd, over and over?
Package that workflow once as a reusable skill.
Package that workflow once, as a reusable skill.
A skill is just one file: .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
A skill is just one file. The skill dot M D file, under dot Clawd slash skills.
Frontmatter says when to use it; the body says what to do.
Frontmatter says when to use it. The body says what to do.
Add !`git diff HEAD` and the live diff is pulled in before Claude reads it.
Add a git diff command, and the live diff gets pulled in, before Clawd reads it.
The folder name is the command: this one becomes /summarize-changes.
The folder name is the command. This one becomes slash summarize changes.
Now just ask what changed — Claude loads the skill on its own.
Now just ask what changed. Clawd loads the skill on its own.
One file. Reused every session, by you or by Claude.
One file. Reused every session. By you, or by Clawd.
Follow for a fresh Claude Code tip every day.
Follow for a fresh Clawd Code tip, every day.
